description: Last-editor-wins (allow-listed last). A non-allow-listed account (stranger-1) first ticks an option, then an allow-listed account (op-1) later edits the same comment and re-ticks the same option. The last edit that ticked it was made by an allow-listed account, so the verdict is one (answer 'next train') — the earlier stranger tick does not void a later allow-listed re-tick.
